DIAQNQSTICS - AUTQMATIQ TRANSAXLE (U24QE)
INSPECTION PROCEDURE
1 Check shift solenoid valve SL 1, SL2 or S4 operation.
Shift solenoid valve SL 1 and SL2 PREPARATION: 2 (a) Jack up the vehicle. (b) Remove the oil pan. CHECK: (c) Remove the shift solenoid valve SL 1, SL2 or S4.
Check Solenoid Resistance: (a) Shift solenoid valve SL 1 or SL2: Measure resistance between terminals 1 and 2 of sole- noid connector. 2 S4: (b) Shift solenoid valve Measure resistance between terminal 1 of solenoid con­ nector and solenoid body. Check Solenoid Operation: (a) Shift solenoid valve SL1 or SL2: 23-W Connect the positive(+) lead with an bulb to termi­ nal 1 and the negative (-) lead to terminal 2 of solenoid Shift solenoid valve S4 connector, then check the movement of the valve. (b) Shift solenoid valve S4: Connect the positive(+) lead with an 2'3-W bulb to termi­ nal 1 of solenoid connector and the negative (-) lead to the solenoid valve body, then check the movement of the OK: valve.
(a) Resistance: 5.1 - 5.5 Q (b) The shift solenoid valve makes operation noise •
G Replace the shift solenoid valve SL 1, SL2 or 54.
Check the bodyI valve (Sae page D1--172).
